name: Captain Katou
source:
A captain belonging to the Imperial Army's military police. He's a monster who singlehandedly stopped the Hibiya riots and disturbances, becoming feared as a "sorcerer" who can use witchcraft and control shikigami due to the dubious legends surrounding him. To Tsukasa, who came from the 21st century, this seems to be nothing more than the occult, but…

[i]"Nobody can know when and how this age we live in will branch out―like the branches of this sakura tree."[i]

[spoiler]He is actually the great great great grandson of Shikura Bansai and his real name is Shikura Benkei[/spoiler]
